movie.title: The Eyes
movie.overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister, renowned photographer Seo-jin embarks on a dangerous investigation into the truth while an unseen presence threatens to strip away her sight and sanity.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Renowned photographer Seo-jin is shattered when her twin sister dies under sudden, mysterious circumstances. Refusing to accept the official explanation, she begins her own relentless investigation to uncover what truly happened. As she digs deeper, an ominous presence closes in, distorting her reality and causing her vision to rapidly fade. Trapped in growing darkness, Seo-jin must face a terrifying revelation that fundamentally shatters everything she believed.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Seo-jin is an acclaimed photographer whose world falls apart following the sudden and unexplained death of her twin sister. Unconvinced by the vague answers provided by authorities, she launches a personal inquiry into the final days of her sister's life. However, her pursuit of the truth quickly triggers unsettling phenomena that seem to stalk her every move. Strange distortions begin appearing around her, mirroring the rapid physical deterioration of her own eyesight. As her vision weakens and the darkness encroaches, her perception of reality becomes increasingly unstable and filled with intense paranoia. Friends and associates begin to doubt her sanity, leaving her isolated in her search for answers. The unseen force grows more aggressive, bending the environment around her and trapping her in a waking nightmare. In a desperate race against complete blindness, Seo-jin uncovers hidden secrets about her sister's past and their shared connection. Ultimately, she is forced to confront a horrifying truth that reframes the true nature of her sister's death and her own identity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Eyes follows Seo-jin, a highly respected photographer whose life is upended by the sudden, unexplained death of her twin sister. Driven by grief and suspicion, Seo-jin immerses herself in an investigation to reconstruct her sister's final moments. Her journey takes a dark turn as a sinister, unseen force begins invading her life, blurring the lines between illusion and reality. Concurrently, Seo-jin begins experiencing a traumatic loss of sight, plunging her into literal and psychological darkness. As paranoia takes hold and the truth draws near, Seo-jin must navigate a maze of chilling secrets before her vision—and her life—disappear entirely.

story_structure.climax: Enveloped in complete darkness and trapped by the encroaching entity, Seo-jin confronts a horrific revelation about her sister, the entity, and the truth behind her vanishing sight.
story_structure.conflict: Determined to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, Seo-jin launches her own investigation, only to be targeted by an unsettling, unseen entity that distorts her perception of reality.
story_structure.resolution: With the shocking reality laid bare, the tragic consequences of the revelation settle as Seo-jin comes to terms with the irreversible aftermath of her discovery.
story_structure.introduction: Seo-jin, a highly acclaimed photographer, suffers a devastating loss when her twin sister dies under sudden and mysterious circumstances.
story_structure.risingAction: As the unseen presence intensifies its harassment, Seo-jin's eyesight begins to deteriorate rapidly, spiraling her into severe paranoia while she races against time to connect the cryptic clues left behind.
